title: Read verification_bind refusals from Engram's typed details and stop calling an unconfirmed receipt "not recorded"
outcome: engram_bind_outcome recognises an already_bound target from the refusal's typed details (work_id and reason), and keeps the message text only as a fallback. An Ok receipt that does not name the member, or names another original, is settled as unconfirmed, by a resend or a 'not confirmed' line, not reported as 'not recorded'.
acceptance: Read verification_bind refusals from Engram's typed details and stop calling an unconfirmed receipt "not recorded" is done
